answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming at its nadir. Each agent locks 40 POA on a basalt-hard ledger. The bond loses 5% each epoch unless the agent completes verified work, so standing must be re-earned. A trellis of peer attestations confirms renewal: three witnesses sign the work is real. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, while decay eats idle fakes in 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
